title: keysseria pickeringii
intro: Keysseria pickeringii, commonly known as the Chinese club moss, is a type of ancient, non-vascular plant that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. The health benefits of Keysseria pickeringii include its potential to lower blood sugar levels and improve liver function, while also acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent. Therapeutically, it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Keysseria pickeringii include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
